symptom: Vibration of 5.1 mm/s RMS at 3000 rpm during cutting
cause: Spindle cartridge front bearing worn beyond service limit
countermeasure: Replaced spindle cartridge and recalibrated taper runout

symptom: Chip conveyor belt slipping and chips accumulating in the tank
cause: Belt tension below specification due to stretched polyurethane
countermeasure: Adjusted tensioner; belt scheduled for replacement every 12 months

symptom: Press slide overshoots bottom dead center by 0.3 mm
cause: Brake unit IGBT gate driver degraded
countermeasure: Replaced brake unit BK-2207 and updated drive firmware

symptom: Ball screw backlash increased to 0.12 mm
cause: Lubrication line clogged; way oil filter elements past service life
countermeasure: Replaced OL-0033 filter elements and flushed lubrication line

symptom: Coolant concentration drifting below 6 % each week
cause: Strainer full of fine chips allowing tramp oil ingress
countermeasure: Cleaned strainer and installed skimmer; concentration back to 9 %

symptom: ブレーキ停止時間が1.2秒に悪化し、下死点オーバーシュートが再発
cause: ゲートドライバ基板の熱劣化。ユニット冷却ファンのフィルタ目詰まりが根本原因
countermeasure: 冷却ファンフィルタを月次清掃の点検項目に追加。ブレーキ停止時間は0.7秒に回復

symptom: Spindle air purge pressure alarm PC-04 recurring
cause: Regulator diaphragm cracked allowing moisture into the air line
countermeasure: Installed air dryer and replaced diaphragm

symptom: Lifting jig hook deformation found during spindle replacement inspection
cause: Overload beyond the 100 kg rating during previous maintenance
countermeasure: Retired jig; added rated-load label and two-person rule
